[RTCT.1.1] **`foo.profile`** — emitted by the profile binary
([RTCT.5]). A full YAML document conforming to [RTCT.3] with
the `contract:` mapping populated from observed peaks
verbatim (no headroom applied) and the `measurement:`
section populated with full observations. The profile binary
overwrites any pre-existing `foo.profile` on each run; it
never touches a `.dsrt`.
